persons.name: Jīvaratna
persons.evidence: cikatamugalapratīlyā brahmacakramahāvihāre sthita vipravaṃśavajrācāryya jīvaratnena likhitaṃ

date.as_written: nepālavarṣe ṛtunetrakhendu, māse śuciś ca dhavale ca pakṣe, vahnitithibhe ca śukravāre

notes: ṛtunetrakhendu = 6, 2, 0, 1 -> NS 1026. The cataloguer identifies śuci as Jyeṣṭha, but in standard Sanskrit lexicography śuci refers to Āṣāḍha. Vahnitithi is the 3rd tithi and vahnibha is the nakṣatra Kṛttikā.
